name: Inoue Shinozaki
source:
The president of the Mathematics Club and the vice president of Class IV-A.

Known for having two different sides: a business-minded lady and a playful girl. She always pushes for one side of the argument with experience as the strongest evidence. "To see is to believe," that is.

[spoiler]After L.C., she is the first major antagonist following a drastic change of psyche during her abduction.[/spoiler]
translation:
The president of the Mathematics Club and the vice president of Class IV-A.

Known for having two different sides: a business-minded lady and a playful girl. She always pushes for one side of the argument with experience as the strongest evidence. "To see is to believe," that is.

[spoiler]After L.C., she is the first major antagonist following a drastic change of psyche during her abduction.[/spoiler]
